# Pull requests are not accepted

This repository is a published export. Each release replaces the tree wholesale, so a merged patch would be overwritten. Maintainers close pull requests without merging them.

Forking is disabled on this repository. To propose a change to Crimson Crawler, close this pull request and open an issue that describes the observed and expected behavior, a minimal reproduction, the relevant version, and any compatibility impact. Report vulnerabilities through the private process in `SECURITY.md`, not through an issue or pull request.
